trail.text: Memory and latency spikes point at user and front-end — I'll dig in to isolate the root cause.
User service dominates the anomaly — now checking related services for wider impact.
Orders is showing latency too — checking timing to determine what's cause versus effect.
Timeline shows user memory spiked first — now gathering final evidence across remaining services.
Core evidence is locked in — now confirming the last victims before finalizing the ranking.

causes.reasoning: User memory explodes 15MB to ~280MB starting at +5s, earliest signal, followed by 350x latency rise, indicating memory pressure causing slowness.
Front-end shows new errors and 30x p99 latency starting at +9s just after user memory, consistent with caller blocked on sick user service.
Orders p50 latency jumps 8x starting at +34s, later than user, suggesting downstream victim of user slowness.
Carts shows small but significant p50 latency rise from +14s, magnitude far smaller than user, consistent with secondary victim.
Catalogue p95 latency rises modestly from +34s with small memory bump, timing and size indicate sympathetic victim not origin.
